records.allocation_scope: ordinary C++ new on tracing thread inside wrappers; excludes caller construction, C malloc, aligned and worker allocation

causal_scope: Seven alternating local microbenchmark pairs support local arithmetic/traversal wins. One full run is an observation on a shared host, not a controlled causal estimate.
measurement_limits: MSM time/percentages cover traced R7 MSM wrappers. Standalone group multiplications, subgroup validation, and all-group CPU share are not measured.

Allocation counts cover ordinary C++ new on the tracing thread within each wrapper; exclude caller construction, direct malloc, aligned and worker allocations. The dedicated scalarCommit benchmark intentionally widens this scope to include its two caller vectors.

Auth map_calls counts defer digest plus fused barrier validation passes; optimized actual mapDigest function calls are 936, plus 936 prepareClaim digest checks. Kernel rehashing in fallback is counted by kernel coordinates, not map_calls.
Weight_products is a traversal-based upper bound in generic/fallback root scans, not a full Fr operation count. Separate deterministic Weights arithmetic and polynomial timings are in raw unit logs.
map_cpu includes fused preparation/Weights/bias work; weights_cpu overlaps it. Do not sum overlapping counters. Kernel time includes allocation, Fr arithmetic and any fallback hash scan.
